title: MODULATION OF ARCHAEAL HYPERNUCLEOSOME STRUCTURE AND STABILITY BY Mg 2+
authors: Zarguit I; Cajili MKM; van Erp B; Schwab S; van der Vis N; Bakker M; van Noort J; Dame RT
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌组蛋白与DNA形成超核小体的结构稳定性及Mg2+调控，属蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但聚焦实验单分子方法，无AI或物理模拟建模，故为中档。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

DNA-wrapping histone proteins play a central role in chromatin organization, gene expression and regulation in most eukaryotes and archaea. While the structure and function of eukaryotic histones are well-characterized, archaeal histones and their complexes with DNA require further scrutiny. Distinct from their eukaryotic counterparts, previously characterized canonical archaeal histones assemble on DNA into an ‘endless’ superhelical nucleoprotein complex called a hypernucleosome. In this study, we explored whether hypernucleosome formation is a conserved feature of canonical archaeal histones. Moreover, to further elucidate how hypernucleosomes are regulated, we also explored how changes in the physico-chemical conditions, particularly the presence of Mg 2+ , influence the hypernucleosome. Using a combination of Tethered Particle Motion (TPM) and single-molecule force spectroscopy, we established that T. kodakarensis histones assemble into hypernucleosomes on DNA, similar to the M. fervidus histones HMfA and HMfB, the only canonical histones structurally characterized in previous studies. However, the effects of Mg 2+ ions are distinct despite the histones’ high sequence- and structural similarity. We propose a model in which Mg 2+ ions exert a generic effect on hypernucleosome compactness and stability due to electrostatic DNA shielding, with additional differential effects depending on histone identity.
abstract_zh:
摘要

DNA包裹组蛋白在大多数真核生物和古菌的染色质组织、基因表达及调控中发挥核心作用。尽管真核组蛋白的结构和功能已被充分表征，但古菌组蛋白及其与DNA的复合物仍需进一步研究。与真核对应物不同，先前表征的典型古菌组蛋白在DNA上组装成一种“无限”超螺旋核蛋白复合物，称为超核小体 (hypernucleosome)。在本研究中，我们探讨了超核小体形成是否为典型古菌组蛋白的保守特征。此外，为进一步阐明超核小体如何被调控，我们还研究了物理化学条件变化，特别是Mg²⁺的存在，如何影响超核小体。通过结合系绳粒子运动 (Tethered Particle Motion, TPM) 和单分子力谱技术，我们确定T. kodakarensis组蛋白在DNA上组装成超核小体，类似于M. fervidus组蛋白HMfA和HMfB——后者是先前研究中唯一被结构表征的典型组蛋白。然而，尽管这些组蛋白具有高度序列和结构相似性，Mg²⁺离子的影响却有所不同。我们提出一个模型，其中Mg²⁺离子通过静电DNA屏蔽对超核小体的致密性和稳定性产生普遍效应，同时根据组蛋白身份产生额外的差异性影响。
